metadata.question: Was there more smoke on January 1, 2020 in the coastal regions of Victoria and New South Wales, Australia compared to July 24, 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. **Search strategy**: - Collect satellite imagery for two dates: January 1, 2020 (Australian summer/fire season) and July 24, 2019 (Australian winter). - Location: Coastal regions of Victoria and New South Wales (NSW), Australia. - Use Sentinel-5P (tropospheric NO2, CO) or MODIS for smoke detection via aerosol optical depth (AOD), or use visual bands to detect smoke plumes. - Sentinel-2 can detect smoke visually; MODIS AOD is a direct smoke proxy. - Consider using multiple datasets for robustness. 2. **Masking strategy**: - For smoke detection, we don't mask smoke—we measure it. - Cloud masking is important to avoid confusing clouds with smoke. - Smoke is typically detected via AOD (aerosol optical depth) or by visual inspection of near-infrared/visible bands. 3. **Logic**: - Calculate mean AOD or smoke index for both dates over the coastal VIC/NSW region. - Compare: if Jan 1, 2020 > July 24, 2019, answer A (more smoke). Otherwise B. - Handle edge cases: If no valid data (C1), no valid pixels after masking (C2), or NaN/invalid result (C3). - Jan 1, 2020 coincides with major Australian bushfires, so we expect higher smoke levels than winter (July 24, 2019). ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define coastal regions of Victoria and New South Wales // Approximate bounding boxes const vicNswCoast = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[141.0, -39.5], [141.0, -28.0], [154.0, -28.0], [154.0, -39.5], [141.0, -39.5]] ]); // Date 1: January 1, 2020 (Australian bushfire season) const date1Start = '2020-01-01'; const date1End = '2020-01-02'; // Date 2: July 24, 2019 (Australian winter) const date2Start = '2019-07-24'; const date2End = '2019-07-25'; // Try MODIS AOD (Aerosol Optical Depth) - direct smoke proxy const modisCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD08_M3'); let col1 = modisCol.filterDate(date1Start, date1End) .filterBounds(vicNswCoast) .select('Optical_Depth_Land_And_Ocean'); let col2 = modisCol.filterDate(date2Start, date2End) .filterBounds(vicNswCoast) .select('Optical_Depth_Land_And_Ocean'); const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { // Fallback: Try Sentinel-5P CO (carbon monoxide proxy for smoke) const s5pCol = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI_CO'); col1 = s5pCol.filterDate(date1Start, date1End) .filterBounds(vicNswCoast) .select('CO'); col2 = s5pCol.filterDate(date2Start, date2End) .filterBounds(vicNswCoast) .select('CO'); const s5pSize1 = col1.size().getInfo(); const s5pSize2 = col2.size().getInfo(); if (s5pSize1 === 0 || s5pSize2 === 0) { console.log(`MODIS: ${size1}, ${size2} | Sentinel-5P: ${s5pSize1}, ${s5pSize2}`); console.log("C1"); return; } } console.log(`Jan 1 2020 Images: ${size1}, Jul 24 2019 Images: ${size2}`); // Compute mean AOD/CO for each date const img1 = col1.first(); const img2 = col2.first(); if (img1 === null || img2 === null) { console.log("C1"); return; } const bandName = img1.bandNames().getInfo()[0] || 'Optical_Depth_Land_And_Ocean'; // Get mean values const stats1 = img1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: vicNswCoast, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2 = img2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: vicNswCoast, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const val1 = stats1.getInfo()[bandName]; const val2 = stats2.getInfo()[bandName]; // Check for valid pixels const count1 = img1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: vicNswCoast, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo()[bandName] || 0; const count2 = img2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: vicNswCoast, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo()[bandName] || 0; console.log(`Jan 1 2020 AOD: ${val1}, Pixels: ${count1}`); console.log(`Jul 24 2019 AOD: ${val2}, Pixels: ${count2}`); if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } if (val1 === null || val1 === undefined || val2 === null || val2 === undefined || isNaN(val1) || isNaN(val2)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare smoke levels if (val1 > val2) { console.log(`More smoke on Jan 1 2020 (${val1.toFixed(3)}) vs Jul 24 2019 (${val2.toFixed(3)})`); console.log("A"); } else { console.log(`Less or equal smoke on Jan 1 2020 (${val1.toFixed(3)}) vs Jul 24 2019 (${val2.toFixed(3)})`); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
